# Platform manifest

The manifest every platform release carries at its root as platform-manifest.yaml (BUILD_PROMPT §12.1). Unknown fields are errors. Infra validates it, derives every name it would create and checks the invariants of contract v2 before anything on the host changes. Schema file: `contract/platform-manifest.schema.json` (JSON Schema draft 2020-12). Check a release with [pinka-platform](cli/pinka-platform.md); the profiles are in [Platform privilege profiles](platform-profiles.md).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contract_version` | constant `2` | yes | The contract version; equals the contract version of the installed infra. |
| `name` | string | yes | Platform name: 2-12 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter; not a reserved platform name. Accounts, units, roles and paths are derived from it. |
| `version` | string | yes | SemVer of the release. |
| `runtime` | one of `python-uv`, `static` | yes | python-uv: infra runs uv sync --frozen (uv.lock at the release root); static: nothing to build. |
| `requires` | array | no | Infra facilities the platform needs; the health gate checks exactly these. A manifest that uses a facility it does not declare is refused (see Facilities in the profiles reference). |
| `services` | array | yes | The platform's services: exactly one controller, at most one inference-broker. |
| `services[].name` | string | yes | Service name: 1-10 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter. |
| `services[].profile` | one of `controller`, `inference-broker`, `sandbox-operator`, `restricted-operator`, `restricted-reader`, `observer`, `untrusted-agent` | yes | Privilege profile (contract/profiles.yml); gpu-trainer is for jobs only. |
| `services[].start` | see `command` | yes | Start command inside the release; for an untrusted-agent, inside its package or (python-uv) below .venv/, which is its own environment. |
| `services[].package` | see `relative_path` | no | The service's own package, a directory inside the release: required for untrusted-agent and refused for every other profile (V6). python-uv: a workspace member, built into an environment of its own with only that package and its locked dependencies, which must all come from a package index; a start command below .venv/ runs from that environment. static: the files the agent runs, and its start command lies inside. The agent sees only this directory and its environment of the release. |
| `services[].after` | array | no | Services of this manifest that start first. |
| `services[].state` | array | no | State directories of the service. |
| `services[].config` | see `relative_path` | no | JSON Schema (inside the release) the service's configuration is checked against. |
| `services[].secrets` | array | no | Names of the service's secrets; never for untrusted-agent. |
| `services[].limits` | object | no | Resource limits within infra's caps. |
| `services[].limits.memory_max` | see `size` | no | MemoryMax of the unit; within infra's cap. |
| `services[].limits.tasks_max` | integer | no | TasksMax of the unit; within infra's cap. |
| `services[].relaxations` | array | no | From the fixed list; never for untrusted-agent. |
| `jobs` | array | no | GPU training jobs, run by infra as containers. |
| `jobs[].name` | string | yes | Job name: 1-10 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter. |
| `jobs[].profile` | constant `gpu-trainer` | yes | Always gpu-trainer. |
| `jobs[].image` | string | yes | OCI reference with registry, pinned by @sha256: digest. |
| `jobs[].command` | array | yes | Command inside the container. |
| `jobs[].inputs` | object | yes | What the job reads. |
| `jobs[].inputs.base_model` | boolean | no | Mount the base model read-only. |
| `jobs[].inputs.datasets` | array | no | Dataset kinds mounted read-only. |
| `jobs[].outputs` | object | yes | What the job produces. |
| `jobs[].outputs.adapter` | string | yes | Name of the adapter the job produces; the only output kind. |
| `jobs[].resources` | object | yes | Container resources. |
| `jobs[].resources.gpus` | integer | yes | 1, or 0 for the CPU-only variant. |
| `jobs[].resources.memory_max` | see `size` | yes | Memory limit of the container; within infra's cap. |
| `jobs[].resources.cpus` | integer | yes | CPUs of the container; within infra's cap. |
| `jobs[].timeout_seconds` | integer | yes | Run time limit; within infra's cap. |
| `jobs[].resumable` | boolean | yes | Whether the job resumes from its checkpoints. |
| `sockets` | array | no | Unix sockets infra creates for the services (connection rules of §12.3). |
| `sockets[].name` | string | yes | Socket name: 1-16 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. |
| `sockets[].service` | string | yes | The serving service. |
| `sockets[].clients` | array | yes | Client profiles, the human classes researchers and admins, and root. |
| `sockets[].untrusted_clients` | boolean | no | A socket dedicated to the agent: untrusted-agent is its only client. |
| `hooks` | object | yes | The four hooks infra drives the platform through (§12.9); health is required. |
| `hooks.migrate` | see `hook` | no | At deployment, before the new release starts. |
| `hooks.drain` | see `hook` | no | Before stopping; argument --timeout &lt;seconds&gt;. |
| `hooks.health` | see `hook` | yes | After start until healthy; pinka status; doctor. |
| `hooks.reconcile` | see `hook` | no | At every start, before the services. |
| `backup` | object | no | What infra backs up. |
| `backup.paths` | array | no | State paths to back up: &lt;service&gt;/&lt;state directory&gt;[/...]. |
| `backup.database` | boolean | no | Whether the platform database is backed up. |
| `content` | array | no | Content packages deployed from their own sources. |
| `content[].name` | string | yes | Package name. |
| `content[].restricted` | boolean | yes | Restricted packages go to the restricted area only. |
| `content[].required` | boolean | yes | Whether the platform refuses to start without it. |
| `docs` | see `relative_path` | no | Documentation directory in the release. |
| `policy` | object | no | The platform's OPA policy. |
| `policy.bundle` | see `relative_path` | yes | OPA bundle directory in the release, loaded read-only. |
| `policy.decision_path` | string | yes | Decision path below /v1/data, for example &lt;platform&gt;/action/decision. |
| `dashboards` | see `relative_path` | no | Grafana dashboards directory in the release (JSON files only). |
| `tools` | array | no | Optional pinned tools from infra's list. |
| `cli` | object | no | The researchers' CLI. |
| `cli.name` | string | yes | Command name linked into /usr/local/bin; not reserved, not an existing command. |
| `cli.run` | see `command` | yes | Command inside the release. |
| `telemetry` | object | no | Telemetry settings. |
| `telemetry.labels` | array | no | Up to 4 resource attributes the collector turns into Loki labels. |

## Definitions

### relative_path

A relative, normalized path inside the release: no leading /, no empty, . or .. segment; a trailing / is allowed for directories.

### command

A command: the first element is a relative path to a regular file inside the release, the others are its arguments.

### size

A size with the suffix K, M or G (systemd style).

### hook

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hook.run` | see `command` | yes | Command inside the release; it prints one JSON line on stdout. |
| `hook.timeout_seconds` | integer | yes | Seconds until SIGTERM, then SIGKILL; within infra's cap. |

## Reserved names

The validator derives every name the manifest would create (accounts, groups, units, database roles, the database, the CLI) and refuses one that is listed here, matches a pattern, or already exists on the host. Generated into `contract/reserved-names.yml`.

| Namespace | Meaning | Names | Patterns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accounts_groups` | Accounts and groups; also every account or group already on the host. | `pinka`, `pinka-admin`, `pinka-build`, `pinka-datasets`, `pinka-grafana`, `pinka-inference`, `pinka-lab`, `pinka-loki`, `pinka-monitor`, `pinka-otelcol`, `pinka-prometheus`, `pinka-query`, `pinka-query-proxy`, `pinka-restricted`, `pinka-tempo`, `root` | — |
| `units` | systemd units, targets and slices (names without .service). | `pinka-backup`, `pinka-backup-prune`, `pinka-compose`, `pinka-core`, `pinka-docker-incus-compat`, `pinka-docs`, `pinka-gpu-arbiter`, `pinka-gpu-arbiter@`, `pinka-gpu-job@`, `pinka-health-gate`, `pinka-hook@`, `pinka-incus-events`, `pinka-inference`, `pinka-inference-control`, `pinka-inference-forwarder`, `pinka-inference-guard`, `pinka-lab.target`, `pinka-nftables`, `pinka-observability`, `pinka-otlp-agent`, `pinka-pgdump`, `pinka-platform.target`, `pinka-run-network`, `pinka-run-network@`, `pinka-security-patch`, `pinka-services.slice`, `pinka-session-start`, `pinka-sleep-inhibit`, `pinka-telemetry-guard`, `pinka-vm-otlp-address`, `pinka-window-expiry` | — |
| `containers` | Container names. | `pinka-cadvisor`, `pinka-gpu-exporter`, `pinka-grafana`, `pinka-loki`, `pinka-node-exporter`, `pinka-opa`, `pinka-otel-gateway`, `pinka-otel-journald`, `pinka-postgres`, `pinka-postgres-exporter`, `pinka-prometheus`, `pinka-query-proxy`, `pinka-tempo`, `pinka-vllm` | `pinka-job-*` |
| `incus` | Incus networks, network ACLs, interfaces, projects and storage pools. | `bench`, `build`, `pinka-build0`, `pinka-otlp0`, `pinka-run-default`, `pinka-targets` | `r-*` |
| `postgresql_roles` | PostgreSQL roles. | `pinka_monitor`, `postgres` | `pg_*` |
| `postgresql_databases` | PostgreSQL databases. | `postgres`, `template0`, `template1` | — |
| `commands` | Commands; also every command already on the PATH. | `pinka`, `pinka-preflight` | — |
| `platform_names` | Platform names. | `infra`, `lab`, `pinka`, `platform`, `pokus`, `restricted`, `root`, `system`, `training` | — |

| Below | Reserved path segments |
| --- | --- |
| `/srv/pinka` | `backups`, `datasets`, `images`, `models`, `platforms`, `restricted`, `services`, `shared`, `state`, `training`, `users` |
| `/etc/pinka` | `gpu`, `incus`, `inference`, `platform`, `postgres-reader`, `qa`, `secrets`, `signing`, `vllm` |
| `/var/lib/pinka` | `fingerprint`, `git`, `gpu`, `platforms`, `run-networks`, `sessions`, `staging` |
| `/run/pinka` | `gpu.sock`, `otlp`, `platform`, `postgres`, `postgres-reader`, `query.sock`, `run-network.sock` |
